name: Sirius Warren Darice
original_name: シリウス＝ウォーレン＝ダリス
source:
Affiliation: Temple
Hobby: Looking in the Mirror
Special Skill: Ventriloquism
Likes: Pretty Things
Dislikes: Ugly Things

A prince from the country of Darice who came to Arolandia as a goodwill ambassador.
He's good with a sword but finds magic to be unpleasant.
A narcissist who often flirts with women and teases serious people, but he rarely shows his true feelings.
He carries around a ventriloquist dummy named 'Bobby'.
